q:
I'm sure the shop was closed because of the holiday. (MUST)
The shop ___ closed because of the holiday.
explain: Pewny wniosek o przeszłości: must have been.

q:
We have almost no time left to finish the report. (SHORT)
We ___ time to finish the report.
explain: Be short of = brakować czegoś.

q:
My advice is to talk to your teacher about it. (WERE)
If I ___, I would talk to your teacher about it.
explain: Rada w II okresie warunkowym: If I were you, ...

q:
Anna began collecting stamps ten years ago and still does. (BEEN)
Anna ___ stamps for ten years.
explain: Czynność trwa do teraz: Present Perfect Continuous.

q:
I met a woman yesterday. Her son is a famous chef. (WHOSE)
I met a woman yesterday, ___ a famous chef.
explain: Zdanie przydawkowe z whose: whose son is a famous chef.

q:
Somebody stole my bike last night. (WAS)
My bike ___ last night.
explain: Strona bierna w Past Simple: was stolen.

q:
As a child, I used to climb that tree every summer. (WOULD)
As a child, I ___ that tree every summer.
explain: Dawny, powtarzający się zwyczaj: would + bezokolicznik.

q:
'Don't touch the machine!' the technician told us. (WARNED)
The technician ___ the machine.
explain: Zakaz w mowie zależnej: warned + osoba + not to + bezokolicznik.

q:
I will never find it easy to speak in public. (GET)
I will never ___ speaking in public.
explain: Get used to + -ing = przyzwyczaić się.

q:
Somebody will paint our house next week. (HAVE)
We ___ painted next week.
explain: Konstrukcja have + dopełnienie + III forma: usługa wykonana przez kogoś.

q:
He was able to solve the problem without any help. (MANAGED)
He ___ the problem without any help.
explain: Manage to + bezokolicznik = udać się coś zrobić.

q:
If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus. (UNLESS)
You will miss the bus ___ hurry.
explain: Unless = jeśli nie: unless you hurry.

q:
'Are you hungry?' she asked me. (WHETHER)
She asked me ___ hungry.
explain: Pytanie zamknięte w mowie zależnej: whether + szyk twierdzący, czas cofnięty.

q:
I think you should spend less on clothes. (CUT)
I think you should ___ spending on clothes.
explain: Czasownik frazowy: cut down on / cut back on (ograniczyć).

q:
It was such a difficult exam that nobody passed it. (SO)
The exam ___ that nobody passed it.
explain: Such + rzeczownik zamieniamy na so + przymiotnik: was so difficult that.
